intuition: Reverse only complete blocks of k nodes; an incomplete suffix must remain in its original order.

brute_force.approach: Collect values in groups, reverse each complete group, and construct a new list.

optimal.approach: Check that a full group exists, reverse its links in place, and connect its new head and tail to adjacent groups.

edge_cases: A list shorter than k remains unchanged.
The last group is left untouched when it has fewer than k nodes.
